findings.rationale: Request actions reject only Pending and Succeeded. After Failed or TimedOut, the original command can be invoked again for the same correlation and resets attempts to 1, bypassing the retry action's max-attempts guard indefinitely.

idempotency_key is only path-validated; no state, guard, lookup, or write derived from it is generated. Effect admission is keyed solely by correlation, so the declared idempotency contract cannot suppress duplicate effects.
Await guards are generated only when step.emits is empty. A normal wait-then-emit step therefore becomes enabled without any awaited event and may emit prematurely or repeatedly.

Every action rewrites all event flags to represent only that action's emissions, while compensation requires trigger_event and after_event flags simultaneously. When those events occur sequentially, observing the latter clears the former, making the compensation unreachable unless one action emits both.

The text renderer extracts only the final field name and obtains its type from handles/request_event, returning None and silently omitting lifecycle state/actions when resolution fails. Direct lowering instead resolves the actual Event.field receiver and errors on malformed or missing correlation, so identical input can produce different key types or lose the effect entirely depending on the lowering path.
